entries.source: Regesta Boica 10 (Regesta sive rerum Boicarum autographa ad annum usque MCCC. 10 = Continuatio 6)
entries.german: Conrad von Rosenberg Vizthum von Amberg, setzt die Abtissin von Pülenhofen in den Besitz der drei daselbst gelegenen Hofstätten. G. Mondtag vor St. Elspethen-Tag.
entries.english: Konrad von Rosenberg, Vizthum von Amberg, puts the abbess of Pülenhofen in possession of the three house plots located there. Given on the Monday before St. Elisabeth's day.

facts.content: put the abbess of Pülenhofen in possession of the three house plots located at Pülenhofen.
